title: AAPS3 re-starts instead of activating edited profile
body:
After I update the pump local profile and save it there appears a button at the bottom saying "activate profile". However, the profile is not activated but AAPS is restarting fresh including the old profile definition. This error is new  to me and never showed up in AAPS2.8.2

Activating the new profile from the Profile-Button on the home screen works as expected.

Here is an example extract from the log:
```
16:37:14.448 [main] D/EVENTS: [RxBus.send():23]: Sending EventProfileStoreChanged[]
16:37:14.545 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-77] D/CORE: [UserEntryLogger$log$2.invoke():45]: USER ENTRY: STORE_PROFILE LocalProfile  [SimpleString(value=ES-Loop)]
16:37:16.394 [main] D/APS: [DialogFragmentWithDate.onStart():57]: Dialog opened: info.nightscout.androidaps.dialogs.ProfileSwitchDialog
16:37:16.899 [main] D/CORE: [MainApp.onCreate():76]: onCreate
16:37:16.903 [main] D/EVENTS: [RxBus.send():23]: Sending EventNewBG[glucoseValue=<null>]
16:37:16.907 [main] D/CORE: [MainApp.onCreate():102]: Version: 3.0.0.1+AAPS3001_ai227
16:37:16.908 [main] D/CORE: [MainApp.onCreate():103]: BuildVersion: 06bbfe663-2022.05.18-23:29
```
